meaning:
Memphis = "haven of the good"
a capital of Lower Egypt located on the western bank of the Nile about 9 miles (15 km) south of Cairo
Another spelling of noph (נֹף, מֹף "Memphis" H5297)

elsewhere.note: For, behold, they have gone away from destruction. Egypt will gather them up. Memphis will bury them. Nettles will possess their pleasant things of silver.…
